title: VLOOKUP_SOURCE
description: Returns the value of the specified field (including relationship fields up to 5 levels) from the first record in the Source Connection that matches all of the given field-value pairs.

parameters.name: source_object_name
parameters.description: The API name of the object in the Source Connection to query.

parameters.name: return_field_name
parameters.description: The API name of the field to return from the matching record.

parameters.name: …matching_field_name
parameters.description: The API name of the field used to match records.

parameters.name: …matching_field_value
parameters.description: The field value used as matching criteria.

parameters.name: additional_clause_optional
parameters.description: Additional SOQL criteria for restricting or ordering the matching results.

examples:
VLOOKUP_SOURCE("Opportunity", 
               "Amount", 
               "AccountId", Id, 
               "StageName = 'Closed Won' ORDER BY CloseDate DESC")
-- Returns the Amount of the most recent Closed Won Opportunity in the Source Connection whose AccountId matches the current Account's Id.
